info.title: Person API
info.description: With this endpoints you can manage the request in your system.

servers.description: Production endpoint (Warning! This will effect your real data)

get.description: Get search everything or a specific ID or just get a list of all requests. This is a really old endpoint that didn't support status codes, so most messages will be under the 200 status code.

parameters.name: request_id
parameters.description: Pass the request ID that you want to search or fill in "search" to look for everything.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Fill in on what you want to search on. You can search on the following fields: first name, last name, company name, phone number, mobile number, email, address, city, zip code, and reference number

parameters.name: date_created_from
parameters.description: The date you want to start searching from based on the date of creation.

parameters.name: date_created_until
parameters.description: The date you want to searching until based on the date of creation.

parameters.name: date_edited_from
parameters.description: The date you want to start searching from based on the date of last time edited.

parameters.name: date_edited_until
parameters.description: The date you want to searching until based on the date of last time edited.

parameters.name: updated_from
parameters.description: The date you want to start searching from based on the last updated date, this search is more accurate. (max. period of 48 hours)

parameters.name: updated_to
parameters.description: The date you want to end searching from based on the last updated date, this search is more accurate. (max. period of 48 hours)

parameters.name: has_account_manager
parameters.description: Filters leads that do or don't have an account manager (current_user_id)

parameters.name: installation_date
parameters.description: The date and time of the installation

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: amount of offset (can start at 0), in combination with the limit key

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Set a limit to the response (max: 300), in combination with the offset key

200.description: All fields that where updated and which value and a success message.

value.error: Not valid params. No PersonID found

429.description: Too many requests. This happens when the rate limit is exceeded. The rate limit is 100 requests per minute or 2000 requests per hour, per api key.

500.description: An error has occurred, please take contact with us.

get.description: Get a person and its data by the given {person_id}.

parameters.name: person_id
parameters.description: Pass an ID of the person you want to retrieve.

200.description: Person data along with a list of requests

message.example: Person with the given ID was not found

error.example: Not valid params. No PersonID found

skip_postcode_check.description: If this option is given and set to true, the postcode and number check will be skipped.

match_person_on_address.description: If this option is given and set to true, persons wont be created when they are already in the system.

language.description: List of available languages: nl, en, de, es (could be this list is outdated, it will return an error with the most recent list of available languages when a other value is given)

client_status_id.description: Ask for the available options. This will be the source of the lead.

second_client_status_id.description: Ask for the available options. This will be the current status of the lead.

second_client_status_id_message.description: A description to the status update of the second_client_status_id

parent_person_id.description: Ask for the available options. This will be the id of the company the person belongs to.

gender.description: options: U = unknown, M = male, F = female, G = group/family

project_address.description: Enter if the person's address does not match the project location

installation_date.description: The date and time of the installation

images.description: Full url's to the images as a string separated by a comma. jpg, jpeg, and png supported.

ra_fields.description: All fields starting with "ra_" will be seen as custom fields, ask us for all options available for your account.

product_type.description: Pass one of the specified values to create a lead with a type connected to the passed product type.
